gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Commanding capitals in Unica One hold one thickness through every curve and bend, with a big lowercase eye. And Noto Sans Avestan sits beneath in a modern sans, its curve tips left open and its x-height tall.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Distinctive lettering from Unica One keeps its stroke contrast at essentially zero, every curve showing daylight inside. But Noto Sans Balinese reads in a modern sans, with short ascenders and breathing room in each round letter that make a long passage go down smoothly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Blunt, tube-bright and loud: Unica One has crossbars as thick as its stems. Noto Sans Bamum then settles into a plain sans with big open counters, so a long passage reads loose and easy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Unica One draws a steady line with no pressure variation, and its lowercase eye is huge. Yet Noto Sans Bassa Vah carries a dominant midsection and open-jawed c, so a long passage reads dense, contemporary and sturdy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-batak: Unica One looks like it was traced with a single marker, commanding and a bit stark. Noto Sans Batak, a plain sans, towers in x-height.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali is a plain sans with capitals barely taller than lowercase and distinctly open mouths, under Unica One's tube-like strokes. Long text moves smoothly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads as a plain sans with swollen, tightly coiled lowercase and apertures that stay easy to read. Unica One is the one to command attention, while this body does the quiet work.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Curves that match the stems exactly define Unica One, every outline traced at one steady thickness. Noto Sans Brahmi follows in sans-serif with a high mean line and open-ended curves, so a longer passage reads light and contemporary.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-buhid: A wire-like line gives Unica One its commanding, distinctive look, with daylight inside every curve. Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous gaps between curve ends and stems, so extended reading stays open.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-carian: Commanding rounded-nib strokes from Unica One end without any swelling at their tips. But if that heading shrinks, Noto Sans Carian, a clean sans with terminals held apart like scissor blades, would carry the page better.
